title: LRU cache that forgets the wrong things
about: A header-only LRU cache with two bugs: reading a key does not refresh it, and writing an existing key duplicates it.
task: The C++ tests in this repository fail: run `make test`. Fix lru.hpp so the cache behaves as its comments describe and every test passes. Do not edit anything under tests/ or the Makefile. Stop when `make test` passes.
